leakage_register.basis: Charging for value already delivered is a policy change; how many customers would accept the new fee vs. close the account is a behavioral response to an untried treatment (concept spec section 7) and cannot be sized from this data.
leakage_register.caveat: 642 profitable customers currently take reward value with no annual fee, totalling $222,376/yr in accrued reward cost the relationship never recovers. That figure is context for a fee decision, not a revenue forecast - actual capture depends on take-up under a champion/challenger test.

leakage_register.basis: expected-loss avoided from EAD reduction (same PD/LGD the bank already uses, target limit sized off PEAK utilization and actual trailing spend - never a single snapshot) plus liquidity cost avoided (LCR outflow rate x yield gap on the limit cut, 12 CFR 249) plus leverage capital freed/consumed (SLR regime only, 12 CFR 217.10) plus peer-benchmarked incremental interest on genuinely stretched good-standing accounts
leakage_register.caveat: regulatory capital relief from decreases is $0 by design (0% CCF on cancellable undrawn lines, 12 CFR 217.33(b)(1)). Economic capital relief (diagnostic only): $117,681. Liquidity cost avoided (included in priced value, separate regime from capital): $8,776/yr. Leverage capital: not charged. This bank is assessed under the Tier 1 leverage regime, which counts on-balance-sheet assets only (R-01) - decreases free $0 and increases consume $0. 1985 customers are flagged for engagement rather than a limit change - their current combined card revenue of $501,524/yr is reported as context, not a forecast of what a campaign would recover (that requires a champion/challenger test, per section 7). That same cohort is also carrying $41,270/yr in liquidity cost on capacity it isn't using - reactivating it doesn't just recover revenue, it cuts that drag too, also contingent on the same pilot (not priced).

leakage_register.basis: repricing value depends on how customers respond - attrition and revolve behavior under a new rate - which is a causal question about a treatment never applied (concept spec section 7). Not sizeable from historical data alone.
leakage_register.caveat: $3,874/yr is the zero-elasticity ceiling: what the gap is worth if every customer stayed and paid it. Real value requires a champion/challenger test.

leakage_register.caveat: contact_center_call: marginal-only ($27,569) - avoided volume does not cross a capacity step; statement_paper: marginal-only ($35,261) - avoided volume does not cross a capacity step

leakage_register.caveat: $510,953 is the trailing-12-month value these 470 customers represent if nothing changes - value AT RISK, not value recoverable. Actual retention uplift requires a champion/challenger pilot.
